services.desc: Discover the adventures waiting for your child this summer at Feiro Marine Life Center! Explore this year’s summer offerings and take the first step toward an unforgettable summer. services.desc: Date: Wednesday, July, 29, 2026Time: 5:30 - 7:30 PMCost: $10 Supplies: Yarn provided but bring your own hooks Join us for Whale Crochet Night, an evening of crochet and learning about marine life! In partnership with Cabled Fiber & Yarn, this program teaches participants to crochet your very own colorful whale while learning a bit about these amazing creatures. This class is BYOH (Bring Your Own Hook) and is best for those who already know the basic crochet stitches (slip stitch, single, increase, and decrease).
